newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala Jan consumer prices rise 1.07 percent.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala Jan consumer prices rise 1.07 percent.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices rose 1.07 percent in January over levels recorded in December, the National Statistic Institute said on Monday.
The inflation figure for the first month of the year compared with a rise of 1.12 percent in January 1996, the institute said. December inflation last year was 0.87 percent.
Year-over-year inflation was 10.80 percent on Jan. 31. Year-over-year inflation at the end of January 1996 was 9.76 percent, it added.
